fields.System.Title: Show overdue badge on invoice list
fields.System.Description:
Collections scan the invoice list for overdue invoices. Today the status is plain text and easy to miss.
The API already returns status and daysOverdue for each invoice, so this is a frontend-only change.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
• In the invoice list, invoices with status Overdue show a badge "Overdue" with the number of days overdue.
  • The badge has an accessible label, e.g. "Overdue, 12 days"; the status is not conveyed by colour alone.
  • Uses the existing design tokens (--acme-color-danger, --acme-color-danger-surface, --acme-radius-pill); no new literal colours.
  • Covered by a unit test.
